en_title: LEGO The Marvel Skyline Set Announced
cn_title: 乐高漫威新套装还原微缩天际线
subtitle: 小城市，大吞噬者
opus_summary: 乐高公布漫威天际线套装，以微缩比例还原漫威宇宙的知名建筑，配有行星吞噬者人仔。套装共含1,261块积木，将于1月发售，还收录多款飞行器与微缩角色。

paragraphs.en: With New York Comic-Con in full swing between now and October 11, LEGO has taken the opportunity to announce a new Marvel LEGO set. It’s a 1,261-piece set called The Marvel Skyline ( see it at LEGO ), and it's an ambitious microscale recreation of the most famous buildings in the Marvel universe, complete with a Galactus minifigure. It will be released in January for $99.99.
paragraphs.cn: 纽约漫展正在热烈举行，活动将持续至10月11日。乐高借此机会公布了一款新的漫威套装，名为The Marvel Skyline，共含1,261块积木。这款套装力求以微缩比例还原漫威宇宙中最知名的建筑，还配有行星吞噬者人仔。套装将于1月发售，售价为99.99美元(约合人民币671元)。

paragraphs.en: LEGO Marvel: The Marvel Skyline includes tiny builds of numerous buildings from the Marvel universe — more than are obvious at a glance. It has the Daily Bugle building from Spider-Man, the Avengers Tower, the Baxter Building from Fantastic 4, and Kingpin’s Fisk Tower, and a lot more besides.
paragraphs.cn: 乐高漫威The Marvel Skyline套装收录了漫威宇宙中众多建筑的微缩模型，数量比乍看之下还要多。其中包括《蜘蛛侠》中的号角日报大楼、复仇者大厦、《神奇四侠》中的巴克斯特大厦，以及金并的菲斯克大厦，此外还有许多建筑。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the buildings, a number of creatures and vehicles are flying through the air. There’s the Avengers Quinjet, the Fantastic 4’s Excelsior ship, and the X-Men’s X-Jet. A microscale Human Torch is making a figure four in the air above the Baxter Building, and there’s even a Chitauri Leviathan swooping around. A microscale version of Spider-Man is also included.
paragraphs.cn: 除了建筑，空中还飞着多种生物和飞行器，包括复仇者联盟的昆式战机、神奇四侠的Excelsior飞船，以及X战警的X-Jet战机。微缩霹雳火在巴克斯特大厦上空划出了数字4，周围甚至还有一头俯冲飞行的齐塔瑞利维坦。套装也包含微缩蜘蛛侠。

paragraphs.en: I know some LEGO fans aren’t fond of microscale sets, but I like them. The super-small sale requires an extra level of creativity in the design, in order to make recognizable things with such a small number of tiny pieces.
paragraphs.cn: 我知道有些乐高爱好者不喜欢微缩套装，但我很喜欢。要用这么少的细小积木拼出能让人认出来的东西，设计师就得在这种极小比例下发挥更多创意。

paragraphs.en: The scale here is such that the Galactus minifigure looks positively huge among the buildings, which is fitting for the character. Basically, the set packs a lot of detail into a small amount of space — and a relatively small number of bricks, for what it depicts.
paragraphs.cn: 在这款套装的比例下，行星吞噬者人仔置身建筑之间，看起来格外庞大，很符合这个角色的形象。总体而言，这款套装在有限的空间里容纳了大量细节；考虑到它还原的内容，所用积木也相对较少。

paragraphs.en: If you’re more of a minifigure-scale fan, LEGO released the Avengers: Doomsday New Avengers Tower ( see it at Amazon ) just a few days ago as one of the October releases . For more, check out the three recently announced LEGO Batman sets (including a legitimately terrifying Joker wall art), and take a look at our picks for the best Marvel LEGO sets available to buy right now.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你更喜欢人仔比例的套装，乐高就在几天前推出了《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》新复仇者大厦套装，这是10月发售的套装之一。
